purpose: Presentation vocabulary for future Creative OS; it never owns Product Truth, policy, publication authorization, brand authority or claims.

global_boundaries.product_identity: Physical identity is immutable; only presentation may change.
global_boundaries.source_grounding: Insets, arrows and detail claims require source-backed evidence.
global_boundaries.public_effects: OWNER_REVIEW_CANDIDATE and ready_for_publish are not publication authorization.
global_boundaries.brand: Existing owner-approved brand assets and rules remain canonical.
global_boundaries.chat_native_terminal: When that route applies, final Hebrew/graphics decisions are fixed before the terminal edit; no fabricated post-call QA.

archetypes.intent: Magazine-cover hierarchy around a dominant real product.
archetypes.environment: continuous credible scene or restrained editorial plate
archetypes.depth: foreground/midground/background only when it strengthens the product
archetypes.typography: clear headline/subhead hierarchy using current brand authority
archetypes.negative_space: reserve a deliberate text zone away from the product
forbidden: text placed across protected product detail

archetypes.intent: Show the real product as the hero inside a believable warm context.
archetypes.depth: context supports scale and atmosphere without obscuring identity
archetypes.typography: short supporting copy only if the scene retains breathing room
forbidden: busy decor that competes with hero

archetypes.intent: Explain real details using source-grounded editorial callouts.
archetypes.hero: main product view plus limited verified details
archetypes.environment: simple enough that evidence remains legible
archetypes.depth: insets may isolate existing source detail only
archetypes.typography: labels describe only verified visible facts

archetypes.intent: Build a source-grounded progression for carousel/reel planning.
archetypes.hero: same verified product identity across the sequence
archetypes.environment: scene/angle changes only when backed by real sources or allowed deterministic render
archetypes.depth: progression may move from context to detail to end frame
archetypes.typography: surface-specific text follows current Visible Text/public-copy authority
archetypes.negative_space: planned per frame rather than overlaid after the fact
forbidden: generative product motion/re-render where current route forbids it
invented Hebrew by an incompatible generator

promotion_requirements: golden visual/reference fixtures defined before behavior change
rollback: Delete or revert Creative OS additions; current still/reel contracts remain authoritative.
